Hymn 161: The Lord Be with Us
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Joseph Barnby
Lyricist/Text Author: John Ellerton
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 161 titled "The Lord Be with Us" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Joseph Barnby and the lyrics were written by John Ellerton.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
